zh.title: 说明
items: 本版在 **0.0.1-beta.48** 之上，聚焦 Provider 连接体验：第三方 / 套餐渠道扩展、品牌图标、添加渠道 Modal 动线，以及删除渠道二次确认。
同步修复 Browser 工作台注册与视觉上下文、生产环境毛玻璃，以及聊天首条消息间距等稳定性问题。

zh.title: 新功能与体验优化
items: **第三方 / 套餐渠道扩展**：服务目录新增 GLM Coding Plan（国区 / 国际区）、Kimi Coding Plan、Moonshot、MiniMax（CN / Global）、火山方舟、小米 MiMo / Token Plan、阿里云百炼 Coding Plan、OpenCode Go（OpenAI / Anthropic）等模板，按官方 endpoint 与鉴权区分区域。
**DeepSeek 官方通道**：官方 API Key 直连 `api.deepseek.com`。
**Provider / 模型图标**：目录与已配置列表展示品牌图标，新增智谱、Kimi/Moonshot、MiniMax、火山、小米、百炼、OpenCode 等资源。
**添加渠道 Modal 动线**：点击服务卡片后以居中 Modal 配置；模板锁定渠道与鉴权（订阅卡只登录、API 卡只填 Key）；官方高级字段默认折叠，展开 / 收起有过渡动画。
**删除渠道二次确认**：删除 Provider 组前弹出危险确认，避免误点。

zh.title: 稳定性修复
items: **Browser 工作台**：等待 workspace 注册后再操作；`ensureBrowserReady` 注入 Agent 工具路径；截图进入视觉上下文。
**生产毛玻璃**：保留 frosted glass，避免生产构建丢失。
**服务目录深色主题**：适配 dark theme 对比与表面。
**Qoder 定价回填**：停止 pricing backfill thrash。
**聊天布局**：首条消息上方增加间距。

zh.title: 发布与通道
items: GitHub Releases 继续提供 Desktop 与 CLI 产物；CLI 安装：`npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@beta`。
`peer --version` 应输出 `peer 0.0.1-beta.49`。

en.title: Overview
items: Built on **0.0.1-beta.48**, this beta focuses on provider connect UX: third-party / coding-plan channel expansion, brand icons, a locked modal setup flow, and confirm-before-delete for provider groups.
Also hardens Browser workspace registration / visual context, production frosted glass, and chat spacing.

en.title: Features and UX improvements
items: **Third-party / coding-plan channels**: service catalog gains GLM Coding Plan (CN / Global), Kimi Coding Plan, Moonshot, MiniMax (CN / Global), Volcengine Ark, Xiaomi MiMo / Token Plan, Aliyun Bailian Coding Plan, and OpenCode Go (OpenAI / Anthropic), with region-aware endpoints and auth.
**DeepSeek official channel**: API-key connect to `api.deepseek.com`.
**Provider / model icons**: catalog and configured lists show brand marks, including Zhipu, Kimi/Moonshot, MiniMax, Volcengine, Xiaomi, Bailian, and OpenCode assets.

**Locked provider setup modal**: picking a service card opens a centered modal; channel and auth method stay locked to the template (sign-in-only for subscription cards, key-only for API cards); official advanced fields collapse by default with expand/collapse animation.
**Confirm before removing a provider**: danger confirm before deleting a provider group.

en.title: Reliability fixes
items: **Browser workbench**: wait for workspace registration; inject `ensureBrowserReady` into the agent tool path; feed screenshots into visual context.
**Production frosted glass**: preserve glass styling in production builds.
**Service catalog dark theme**: adapt catalog surfaces for dark mode.
**Qoder pricing backfill**: stop thrashing price backfill.
**Chat layout**: add spacing above the first message.

en.title: Release channel
items: GitHub Releases continue to ship Desktop and CLI artifacts. CLI install: `npm i -g @peer-agent/cli@beta`.
`peer --version` should print `peer 0.0.1-beta.49`.
